title: Cyclic orbit root model over an ind-etale local limit
statement: Let R be a commutative regular ring, g a nonzerodivisor with R/(g) regular, and n>0 invertible in R. Let p:Y→Spec R factor through D(g). Suppose that the pullback of Y along the punctured root cover R[t]/(t^n-g) is a disjoint union of d copies of that punctured cover, with the isomorphism respecting its projection. Let y∈Spec R contain g. Then p is affine and locally of finite presentation. There exist a commutative ring H in the same universe, an ind-etale ring map ι:R→H, and x∈Spec H with Spec(ι)(x)=y, and a finite list of positive integers e(k) invertible in H. The base change Y×_R Spec H is isomorphic over Spec H to the basic open D(ι(g)) in the spectrum of the product of H[t]/(t^e(k)-ι(g)). The proof constructs H as the strict henselization at y; only its ind-etaleness, point, and orbit model are needed downstream.

proof.text: Choose the factor j in hj. Apply root_split_factor_finite_etale to the supplied splitting and its projection identity. The basic-open inclusion is affine and locally of finite presentation; j is affine because finite and locally of finite presentation because etale. Composition and hj yield both properties of p.
Apply regular_divisor_strict_local_limit at y to obtain H, iota, its strict local and regularity instances, regularity and maximal-ideal membership of iota(g), ind-etaleness, and x mapping to y.

Apply root_split_strict_local_orbits to this fixed H and the finite etale factor j, retaining the supplied splitting. It yields the product root model, projection identity and positive orbit degrees e(k) dividing n. Map the unit n through iota. Cast the divisibility e(k)|n to H, and use isUnit_of_dvd_unit to prove all e(k) are units. Assemble these data with the properties of p and the pointed ind-etale limit.

theorem root_split_cover_indEtale_charts
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n ∧ IsUnit (n : R))
    [IsRegularRing R] (hg : IsSMulRegular R g)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {g})]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (hj : ∃ j : Y ⟶ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g),
      j ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) = p)
    (d : ℕ) (y : Spec R) (hy : g ∈ y.asIdeal) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap R A g)
    ∀ (δ : pullback p (V.ι ≫ q) ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ V.toScheme),
      δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 V.toScheme) =
        pullback.snd p (V.ι ≫ q) →
    (IsAffineHom p ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation p) ∧
    ∃ (H : CommRingCat.{u}) (ι : R →+* H) (x : Spec H),
      ι.IndEtale ∧
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) x = y ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (e : Fin m → ℕ),
        (∀ k, 0 < e k ∧ IsUnit (e k : H)) ∧
        let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
          AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ι g))))
        let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap H (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ι g)))))
        let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
          (algebraMap H (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ι g))) (ι g))
        ∃ γ : pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) ≅ V.toScheme,
          γ.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ q = pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))
